In light of the current shortfall of inflation from 2 percent, the Committee will carefully monitor actual and expected progress toward its inflation goal.

The term premium should remain sticky in a range, with no fresh Fed easing bias or major issuance shock to drive it lower, nor any sustained demand shock to drive it sharply higher.
